headline: B200 index climbs +12% in 7 days to $8.38 while every other tracked GPU holds flat.
bullets: B200 rose +12% over 7 days to a $8.38 market index, with a $14.12 hyperscaler median versus $7.99 at neoclouds, a +77% premium.
H200, H100 SXM, MI300X, A100 80GB SXM and L40S all posted a +0% 7-day change, at indexes of $5.40, $4.32, $3.45, $2.70 and $1.50 respectively.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +162% ($10.68 hyperscaler versus $4.07 neocloud), and it is the only GPU listed by all 12 providers.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, and RunPod Community Cloud lists it at $0.50, though only 5 providers offer it.
A100 80GB SXM is the most expensive per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite its $2.70 index, so the cheaper hourly rate does not mean cheaper compute.
watch: Watch whether B200's +12% climb continues or begins pulling up H200 pricing, which currently sits at a $5.40 index with a +0% 7-day change.
